Thanks for the discovery call earlier, Vivek — Tom and I walked away with a much clearer picture. We're ready to move to a technical deep-dive focused on how Redwood would serve our multi-tenant batch inference jobs, VPC network restrictions, and key management.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical session next week? TL;DR what we'd like covered:
- end-to-end request flow for batch + streaming use cases
- VPC peering options and network routing constraints
- key management / encryption at rest and in-flight (HSM questions)
- example capacity profile for 1k TPS burst with p95 latency targets

Our windows:
- Tue 2027-03-30 between 10:00–14:00 PT
- Wed 2027-03-31 after 12:00 PT

Attendees from our side: Tom (platform lead), Asha (product). If you have an SE and someone from product to run through pricing/committed capacity options that would be great.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Head of Platform
SignalForge

Hi Asha / Tom — great to hear and glad the discovery was productive. Ben (SE) and Lauren (Account Exec) are looped in to join the deep-dive.

We can do a 75-minute slot to cover the topics you listed and leave ~15 minutes for open Q&A and next steps. Proposed agenda:
1) 10 min — brief recap of current architecture and goals (SignalForge)
2) 25 min — Redwood architecture walkthrough (runtime, routing, KV cache, autoscaling)
3) 15 min — network & security (VPC, peering, routing, KMS/HSM options)
4) 15 min — capacity sizing and cost levers (batch vs streaming profiles)
5) 10 min — next steps / action items (SOW, PoC options)

We have availability on:
- Tue 2027-03-30 at 11:00 PT (60–75m)
- Wed 2027-03-31 at 13:30 PT (75m)

I also attached a draft agenda and a quick sketch of the default inference topology we typically propose for multi-tenant batch workloads. If you want a deeper dive on HSM integrations we can bring our security engineer on the call.

Let me know which slot you prefer and I'll send a calendar invite + meeting notes doc.
